hits.title: Osmo Gives Every Storyteller the Power of a Production Studio
hits.snippet: Osmo Gives Every Storyteller the Power of a Production Studio **SAN FRANCISCO, August 05, 2026** --( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com) )--Every company has a storyteller. The person who can already picture a distinctive launch video, a vivid product reveal, or a powerful title sequence, fully formed in their head. For years, they've had no way to make it real themselves. Video and motion design lived inside professional tools that take years to master, or behind a queue of specialists, or lately, inside a prompt box that promises to bottle taste inside an AI model. Today, [Osmo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fosmo.inc%2F&esheet=54583732&newsitemid=20260805820358&lan=en-US&anchor=Osmo&index=1&md5=54102b10d9d7c977c0da80700419709f) , the storytelling studio with a software factory, is making its end-to-end video product generally available to storytellers and GTM teams at high-growth companies. The company was founded by a team with backgrounds from A24, NBC, and Saturday Night Live.
